mu_name_from: NPC/tersia.bmd, loaded as MODEL_TERSIA (ZzzOpenData.cpp:2220-2222, its textures out of Npc\), MuMain's MONSTER_MERCENARY_GUILD_FELICIA, whose ID is the Korean for 'Guild Manager Tersia' (ZzzCharacter.cpp:15005-15010). Type 566, OpenMU's 'Mercenary Guild Felicia' (VersionSeasonSix/NpcInitialization.cs:818). Not Version075's.
why_this_one: The user asked for her in the Lost Tower's safe hall in place of Senatus (2026-10-01); placement and her quest are the user's. A purple-haired woman in dark purple leather armour and boots: 1314 triangles on six sheets, 60 bones, two idles.
scale_from: CreateCharacter stands her at `c->Object.Scale = 0.93f` (ZzzCharacter.cpp:15009), MU's own and not this mesh's: whoever stands her owes the 0.93, as a placement's scale. No lift, no BlendMesh, no subtype.
actions_from: Two idles, both kept (export-rig --actions=all): action 0 eight keys, action 1 twenty-two.
play_speed_from: OpenNpc's late overrides (ZzzOpenData.cpp:2276-2278) give her MONSTER01_STOP1 (action 0) PlaySpeed 0.35 and MONSTER01_STOP2 (action 1) 0.3. Not carried: a townsperson's clips are exported at export_gltf's flat DEFAULT_PLAY_SPEED 0.25 and the npc recipe has no per-action speed (only a monster's `monster.model_index` or the player's actions.json reach --speeds). So as built her idles run slow: action 0 at 0.25/0.35 = 71% of MU's rate (8 keys over 1.28 s where MU takes 0.91 s), action 1 at 0.25/0.3 = 83% (3.52 s where MU takes 2.93 s). Owed.
draw_from: RenderObjectMesh's MODEL_TERSIA case (ZzzObject.cpp:2478-2482): the body drawn as it is, then mesh 0 (seta, her armour) again RENDER_BRIGHT | RENDER_CHROME at alpha 0.4 -- an added chrome sheen over the armour. Not drawn yet; this is the opaque body alone.
sheet_from: Out of Data/NPC, beside the model, decoded under an npc_ prefix. npcpharmercy01 and npcpharmercy01a are another NPC's sheets (a merchant's page with a pouch and a feather), which tersia.bmd borrows for 16 and 2 triangles.
sheet_materials_from: seta paints her armour with bare skin at the neckline on the same page, so skin, as every townsperson's shared page does; setb is a chain and spiked trim, terhead her face. wmerhair is her hair, npcpharmercy01a a feather, npcpharmercy01 a painted page of leather and cloth.
cutout_from: The three .OZT sheets carry a real alpha, and it is the shape: setb cuts away 30% (the chain and the spikes on black), wmerhair 8% (the ends of the locks), npcpharmercy01a 74% (a feather on a square). Keyed off that alpha, not off brightness.
islands_from: Found by the build, then assigned by sheet, the triangle counts matching export-obj's per mesh: 16 (182) is all of wmerhair, hair; 1 (2) is npcpharmercy01a's feather, feather; 15 (304) is terhead, her face. The rest are seta's armour, setb's chain and trim and npcpharmercy01's page, skin. The build welds 1314 triangles to 1304 (clean_lowpoly drops ten).
